data.text:

Simulated both dispatch_human_check and cut_power_circuit B: no improvement over do-nothing on temperature margin in this horizon, so no safety-gated auto-action is justified - a cut would be drastic with no demonstrated benefit.

Info notice sent. No automatic action taken. Recommend human inspect Rack B strip / UPS connector at next opportunity and keep watching M2 trend - if rise continues, escalate to warn and re-evaluate.
